label: Static website
description: Plain HTML, CSS and a little JavaScript: no build step, opens in any browser.
task: Scaffold a static website in this empty folder with no build step. Create index.html with a header, a main section and a footer, css/styles.css (responsive, readable on a phone), js/main.js with a small progressive enhancement, and an about.html linked from the navigation. Use semantic HTML and good contrast. Add a package.json with one script, test, that runs node --test on tests/site.test.mjs, which checks that every page links its stylesheet and that every internal link points to a file that exists. Add a README.md that says how to open the site (open index.html, or serve the folder with any static server) and how to run the check. Publish-ready: every page has a <title> and a meta description, Open Graph tags with a social preview picture (assets/social-preview.png, 1200 x 630), a favicon (favicon.svg) and a 404.html page that links home. No trackers, ads or analytics, and no fonts, scripts or pictures from other websites: use the system font stack, and where a picture belongs put a marked image slot (a box that says which picture goes there, its file name in assets/ and its size; list them in assets/README.md) instead of a stock photo. Write every word in the language of the request, and set <html lang> on every page to that language. Never invent the owner's facts (prices, hours, addresses, testimonials): mark each [Fill in: ...] and list them in the README.
